Name: JP's Utility Machines - Seeds Clonator - Seeds Synthesizer
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Seed Synthesizer Machine[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Why bother going to the store to buy seeds when you can clone them from the comfort of your own home![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Robin's store you will find 4 machines capable of cloning any seed you put inside, it only needs a few days. The better the machine the more copies at a time it will produce. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The older machine has problems operating on rainy days and in winter, and the more expensive one cannot be placed indoors for obvious safety reasons.[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]It also works with seeds added from other Mods, as long as they fall into the “Seeds” category.[/color][/size]
[/list][/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=5]It works in the same way as the crystalarium, it has a very simple operation. I hope you enjoy it. [/size][/color]


[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
